zh.summary: 插件市场补齐安全安装与更新反馈，发行下载重新聚焦真正可搬迁的 Portable 成品。
highlights: 插件安装会校验依赖目录和补丁结果；遇到尚未发布的官方 DSH peer 时只进行一次受限重试，不会放宽第三方依赖。
插件更新会显示在任务面板中；取消、失败、完成与刚发布版本确认都有明确状态，不再像后台无响应。
备份恢复会识别无法随目录迁移的绝对 file 和 link 依赖，避免恢复后留下指向旧电脑或旧目录的链接。
内置市场选择性跟进 dsh-market v1.21.1，并增加每日上游差异提醒；只吸收适合 Portable 的修复，不自动覆盖本地实现。
新版下载只保留便携启动器、离线包和各平台便携成品；需要传统安装流程的用户可从文档前往成熟桌面客户端。

en.summary: Completes safe plugin installation and update feedback while refocusing downloads on genuinely movable Portable builds.
highlights: Plugin installs validate the dependency store and patch result; an unpublished official DSH peer gets one bounded retry without relaxing third-party dependencies.
Plugin updates now appear in the activity panel with explicit cancelled, failed, completed, and fresh-release confirmation states.
Backup restore reports absolute file and link dependencies that cannot move with the folder instead of silently reconnecting to an old machine path.
The bundled market selectively adopts dsh-market v1.21.1 and adds a daily upstream review signal without overwriting Portable-specific behavior.
New releases publish only the bootstrap, offline archive, and portable builds for each platform; users who prefer a conventional installer are directed to mature desktop clients.
